dedupe_keys.name: survey dataset on disruptions and disruption management in industrial assembly in germany austria and switzerland 2015 2016

description: This dataset holds anonymised answers from a 2015 and 2016 survey on disruptions in industrial assembly. The Mendeley Data page says more than 100 managers and leading experts responsible for assembly or its planning, in companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, answered questions on the causes, effects and handling of disruptions, together with company data such as the type of assembly organisation, company size and product type. It was published in June 2020 by Johannes Wagner as part of his RWTH Aachen University doctoral thesis, as one Excel file of about 49 KB with the questionnaire and a variable list in English (PDF), free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is manufacturers in the three countries. Caveats: it is a one-off opinion survey with a small sample, and the exact number of responses and the sampling method are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives reported disruption causes, frequencies and responses to parameterise agent-based and discrete-event models of how factories react when inputs, staff or equipment fail. Related catalogue records include the RETHINK-GSC supplier disruptions survey and the global supply chain logistics data for an excavator.
